Nice!

I think [Everforest](https://github.com/sainnhe/everforest) is one of the most beautiful color schemes out there. Plus it has pretty wide Neovim support (including 'mini.nvim') and pretty solid code. So I'd consider using it directly.

If not, then this is definitely a close second choice :)

reply_data.body: Well, the only minor issue I see with everforest is that it is written in vimscript :(. Although it does not matter at the very least, I made a decision to only use lua only plugins as much as possible, plus the fact that my config is just mini plugins for the most part. Hence, I thought might as well put in the effort to write it using mini.base16.
